headline: As of 2026-10-07: 1,801,860 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 32 of 50 states, D+31.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,801,860 early/mail ballots cast so far across 32 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+31.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (422,252), Florida (278,092), Michigan (252,707).
